issues.description: Constructor signature mismatch for class StockIngredient: the problem statement UML and the solution implementation define a three-parameter constructor StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity). The template repository's StockIngredient class only provides a four-parameter constructor StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity, boolean strictValidation). The template's Main (example usage) and the UML expect to call new StockIngredient("Bacon", 10, 50), which will not compile against the template's four-argument constructor and will confuse students implementing SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery and other code that instantiates StockIngredient with three arguments.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a three-argument constructor public StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity) to the template StockIngredient class (for example overload the existing constructor and delegate: this(name, price, quantity, false) or implement equivalent initialization). This aligns the template with the UML, the example Main usage, and the solution, preventing compilation errors and student confusion.
